??? quote "Dialogue"

    - I am Tick! Gate messenger. I run messages from the gate to everywhere else, by stairs and alleys. Da is Knox, the big one on the gate. I am going to be an adventurer. Da says I am going to be a joiner. We will see.
    - I read your check out to Hatch. "Water ran the right way. Octopi plenty, and cross." He said that is the most honest line in the whole notebook. I nearly fell over.
    - Kite is in capitals on the list now. Underlined. I ran the alley route twice this morning. Still slower. Still going to do it.
    - A buried city! Under our feet! Because of page fifty-two! I have started a new volume just for Low Grad. It is called Volume Four: Underneath.
    - Brindle read page fifty-two and went very still, and then took it to the Table! And Brindle saluted me. Properly. I am never washing this hand. That is not how saluting works, but still.
    - Version four is my favourite page in all the books. Da asked me to read it to him twice. He went very quiet after. Good quiet, I think.
    - Do you want to hear something from the notebook? Or ask me something? I know everything at this gate.
        - *Choice:* What is in your notebook?
        - *Choice:* Kite's record?
        - *Choice:* Why Hatch?
        - *Choice:* Nothing. Goodbye.
    - Every strange story a traveler tells me, with their name and the date. A talking crow on the road from Kaldemor. A ford that ran backwards for an evening. A stag with antlers like a burnt tree. Lights moving in a wood where nobody lives.
    - I do not judge them. Some are nonsense. Some are not, and those are coming more often. Zip's arm is in there three times. Three versions. All told by Zip.
    - And page fifty-two, the wanderer and the warm stone. Velvet still has it at her stall. She will not say what she thinks it is. I asked. She told me a different story instead. I wrote that one down too.
    - Kite holds the record from the Gate Walk to the Great Hall, over the roofs. I am going to beat it by the streets. Everybody says it is impossible. I write their names down so I know who to tell. The list is long. It is good motivation.
    - Thirty years on the roads! He can smell rain a day early. He can tell a hungry animal from something worse. He pretends I annoy him, and then he answers every single question.
    - One day I want to walk out of that gate with his blessing. Da does not like it. I am winning the argument at supper. I do not know why winning makes Da look so tired.
    - Salute! Bye! Running!
